reason: Accepted claims document nine gods by name and judgment over Set/Horus rule, with Heliopolis as worship context. Neither full quotes nor statements describe the nine individual bodily forms or attributes. Drawing conventional crowns, animal heads, weapons or other identifying traits would import unsourced iconography; nine plain ordinary people cannot reliably meet the group requirement for distinct imposing divine subjects. Declined under GAMBAR 6.5 rather than inventing individual anatomy/attributes; no image generation calls were made for Ennead.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: No render attempted: accepted claim statements and full quotes reviewed, physical iconography is insufficient. No outside source or conventional iconography imported.
